d:
A hardcore barfest kicks off from one corner of the ring as Naam Sujal steps in with his signature witty flows and lethal punchlines, ready to dismantle his opponent. With every line, he weaves in subliminal disses, carefully referencing past feuds that hit hard and leave a mark. His delivery is sharp, his wordplay on point, and his confidence unmatched as he takes aim at his rival, not just through direct bars but through clever wordplay and subtle jabs that resonate deeply. This is a lyrical battle where history meets heat.

Track Name: Blueprint
